arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one NEW full-body neutral visual-novel sprite of Prune from Genshin Impact on a genuinely transparent background.
INPUT IMAGES: Image 1 is the user's attached in-game model, authoritative for exact outfit construction, accessories, colours, asymmetry, hair and eye design. Image 2 is her installed Official Art portrait, guiding polished Genshin anime illustration style, clean expressive linework, soft painterly/cel shading and facial character. Combine these two authorized sources. Retain the full outfit from the model even where the portrait's action pose obscures it. The existing generated neutral is NOT an input.
IDENTITY, TINY BUILD AND CUTE FACE: make Prune noticeably tinier and cuter, with the compact childlike Small Female silhouette of the model. Aim for approximately four head-lengths overall, with an oversized softly rounded anime head, a very small upper body, narrow delicate shoulders, a short gently rounded torso, and distinctly short thighs and lower legs. Keep her low waist-to-ground distance and little hands, with the large cuff and boot details reading charmingly chunky on her tiny frame. Use natural softly rounded arms and legs, coherent joints and balanced anatomy. Keep the outfit fitted to this smaller body rather than using long legs or a slender adult torso. Her face is rounder and softer, with gently full cheeks, large rounded violet-purple eyes, small delicate nose, tiny smiling mouth and a subtle warm cheek tint on fair skin. Keep the irises and pupils intact and her gaze coherent. A sweet quietly curious expression and soft head tilt should emphasize her cute personality. Preserve recognizable Prune features: short indigo-blue bob with purple/magenta highlights, side-swept fringe, the exact silver bone-shaped hair clip, opposite side ornament, upright violet-pink feather/ribbon details and layered hair from the model. Neutral illumination and her true fair complexion.
COSTUME: match the model's black oversized shoulder wrap/armour-like collar, magenta lining, silver mechanical chest clasp, dark choker and diamond-shaped front ornament; white geometric-edged front tunic panel over black shorts; two lavender hanging panels with pale star motifs, blue-violet geometric patterns and round silver lower fasteners; long dark side/back coat panels with purple and pink layered angular lining; substantial dark wrist cuffs and short fingerless gloves with their exact silver and pink hardware; asymmetric legs, with the anatomical left thigh in its long dark wrap/stocking and upper strap/ornament while the anatomical right thigh is bare above its shorter grey sock. Preserve the model's black lace-up boots, bone-shaped silver side details, metal ankle hardware and pale zigzag toe caps. Keep dark fabric dark, lavender and magenta accents clear, and silver fittings readable without borrowing the blue environment cast.
NEUTRAL ACTING: relaxed standing idle, facing mostly toward the viewer with a subtle comfortable weight shift and feet apart. A tiny sweet closed-mouth smile and wide, softly attentive open eyes, with a slight inquisitive head inclination. Both arms rest low and slightly away from the torso, empty hands relaxed and apart, fingers loosely grouped at natural side angles. Do not copy the portrait's large hammer or pointing/action pose. Keep both hands clear of adjacent fabric and leg contours. Each naturally articulated hand has a palm, four gently curved fingers and a separate opposable thumb; let the angle naturally hide overlapping digits instead of splaying them. Exactly two coherent legs and two feet, no crossing or extra limbs. Hair, heavy panels and ribbons hang naturally with gravity.
FRAMING AND FINISH: a single complete silhouette from the top ornament to both boot soles, filling about 92–96% of the canvas height with roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Preserve readable full costume detail and petite scale while using the frame well; no large blank margins. True transparent alpha outside the character. No scenery, blue backdrop, floor, ground shadow, reflection, border, hammer, weapon, additional prop, floating effects, text, labels, UI, watermark or other characters. Produce one sprite, not a comparison sheet.
